description.value: The Rogers Pass Discovery Centre is a Parks Canada visitor information facility at Rogers Pass in Glacier National Park, perched at one of the most historically significant mountain crossings in Canada — the original route of the CPR transcontinental railway through the Selkirk Mountains. Operated by Parks Canada and tagged as both a historic site and information office, the centre interprets the natural and human drama of this avalanche-prone alpine corridor. Cyclists riding the Trans-Canada Highway through Glacier National Park pass directly through Rogers Pass, making this a natural and notable landmark stop.
